meanings.note: Privative prefix 'без-' ('without, -less') (stem 'дельничать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to loaf around, be idle'.

examples.text: Вы не должны стоять и бездельничать.

найтись.gloss: to be found, to turn up

meanings.en: to be found, to turn up
meanings.note: When something lost is found again. Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'йтись'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to be found, to turn up', paired with 'находиться'.

examples.trans: Say thank you that the dog was found.

examples.text: Опоздал ты, Аркаша. Другие люди нашлись.
examples.trans: You're too late, Arkasha. Other people came along.

+ genitive. Core Russian part meaning 'no; there isn't' in everyday speech.
Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ычно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
